Check that a gene list name can be used

Source: R/fct_gene_lists.R
check_gene_list_name.Rd

Gene lists share one namespace whatever their origin, and their name is the key indexing clustering and network inference results. Returns TRUE if usable, else the message to display, so callers can do if (!isTRUE(msg)) shinyalert::shinyalert(msg, type = "error").

check_gene_list_name(
  name,
  existing_names = character(0),
  allow_key_separator = FALSE,
  max_nchar = 50
)

Arguments

name

candidate name, checked after trimws()

existing_names

names already taken. Each caller decides what counts as taken : the import module forbids all of them, the DEA only the imported ones so that re running an analysis under the same name stays possible.

allow_key_separator

whether " + " is allowed. It is the separator of joined keys, so it is ambiguous, but DEA automatic names contain it by construction ((C + M) (H)). Forbidding it reduces the ambiguity without closing it : A + B + C already collides with A + B + C.

max_nchar

maximum length allowed

Value

TRUE, or a character message

Examples

DIANE::check_gene_list_name("Heat responsive family")
#> [1] TRUE
DIANE::check_gene_list_name("")
#> [1] "Please give a name to this gene list."
DIANE::check_gene_list_name("My list", existing_names = c("My list", "(C) (H)"))
#> [1] "The gene list 'My list' already exists."
DIANE::check_gene_list_name("stress A + stress B")
#> [1] "A gene list name cannot contain ' + ', used by DIANE to name\n           combinations of gene lists."
DIANE::check_gene_list_name("(C + M) (H)", allow_key_separator = TRUE)
#> [1] TRUE
DIANE::check_gene_list_name("None")
#> [1] "This name is reserved by DIANE, please choose another one."
